title: CHX Cord Care Analysis
description: Neonatal mortality is very high in sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia, and a common cause of infection is via the umbilical cord. CHX antiseptic is a very effective way of reducing that risk of infection.

title: Feeding the world without the sun
description: Nuclear winter can cut global crop calories by ~90%. We model how fast lignocellulosic sugar production can scale to close that gap, showing build speed matters far more than decision speed.

title: Which Origami Patterns Can Become Disaster Shelters?
description: In 2025, 117.8 million people were forcibly displaced worldwide, 68.7 million of them internally. Less help has been given and so I seek to find a way to help shelter those who desperately need it.

title: The Green Guard
description: Wound infections drive antimicrobial resistance through unnecessary treatment. Our biodegradable bandage detects and counters infection only when necessary, reducing overuse and improving health.

title: Identifiable Recovery of Conditional Features by Tensor Decomposition of a Layer's Weights
description: A model can hide harmful behaviour behind two conditions holding at once, and current interpretability tools read each feature linearly; hence, interpretability for non-linear features is important.

title: Prioritizing Under Constraint: Targeting Menstrual Health Resources in Climate-Vulnerable Communities
description: I chose menstrual health in climate disasters; many organizations hand out supplies, but none can say which communities need them most. So I built a framework to rank vulnerability and allocate funds.

title: Tairseach: Machine Learning for Social Housing Equity in Ireland
description: An empirical data analysis of government data to assess housing stress in Ireland, assess the impact of Rent Pressure Zone designation, social housing income thresholds and classify housing stress.

title: Linguistically-Informed Morphological Segmentation: Expanding AI Technologies to Under-Resourced Languages
description: Thousands of under-resourced and indigenous languages lack support in AI and language technologies, marginalizing their speakers. I propose and implement a novel linguistically informed solution.

title: To what extent are poorer countries vulnerable to global environmental dangers, and how can charities help?
description: We created a model for charities to optimize funds and assess disaster impact to impoverished nations. As emergency resources are finite, mathematical allocation maximizes life saving welfare.

title: How sustainable is the current Global Population?
description: This is on population growth and whether it is sustainable. It is important as it shows what areas the world needs to improve in to give everyone a positive quality of life and decrease poverty.

title: Nkwa Alert: A Threshold-Triggered SMS Early Warning System for Flooding, Malaria, and Cholera in Ghana
description: Floods, malaria, and cholera kill thousands in Ghana yearly, hitting hardest those without phones or data plans. Nkwa Alert sends SMS warnings and health tips to any phone, no data or app needed.

title: Information-efficient intelligence: A framework for adaptive information acquisition in AI
description: AI systems often process far more input than needed, wasting energy, time and computing resources. Our project enables models to acquire only the information required for reliable decisions.

title: Predicting the probability of AI taking over the human race
description: The biggest fear right now is whether AI will take over humanity, therefore I want to investigate whether this fear is true and show that AI is something to aid us if used correctly, not to be feared.

title: A Physical Solution to the Aflatoxin Crisis
description: Aflatoxins are deadly, heat-resistant fungal toxins that affect crops such as maize and peanuts. Affecting over 500 million people, they cause severe liver failure, cancer, and stunted growth.

title: Defeating AI Surveillance
description: I chose AI Governance. Technology is becoming increasingly sophisticated, privacy of individuals is nothing but an illusion; to tackle this problem I made this encryption and decryption algorithm.

title: Effective Food Bank Allocation Resource Distribution
description: This project tackles inefficient food bank distribution by replacing arbitrary equal splits with a needs-weighted data model, ensuring fixed donation pools directly match local food insecurity.

title: Mechanism Design for Public Digital Queues in Price-Controlled Systems
description: Every scarce public resource eventually attracts strategic behaviour. Pretending otherwise is policy by wishful thinking. China is a utopia if one wants to study these complex interactions.

title: Belief Vector Field under AI alignment
description: This project introduces Believe-LLMs, an alignment-first open-source scientific framework that monitors intrinsic geometric signals inside transformer-based models layer-by-layer.

title: Dubai Flash Flood Risk Predictor
description: My project tackles flood risk safety in Dubai by analysing rainfall, drainage, elevation, traffic and flood history to identify danger zones and give clear driving and safety advice.

title: A Convolutional Neural Network for Classifying Spectral Signatures of Falsified and Substandard Antimalarials
description: Fake and substandard antimalarials cause preventable deaths and accelerate drug resistance. Our CNN identifies these compromised pills from NIR spectra to remove them from circulation.

title: A simulation-based engineering training platform for wastewater networks
description: Wastewater utilities struggle to quantify overflow risk and compare mitigation costs consistently. This project provides clear equations linking risk, cost, and performance to guide decisions.

title: What will AI misalignment look like in the future?
description: The consequences of AI misalignment and how we can help. Very large cause area in website rankings and a few incidents in the news recently.

title: Nudge don't Destroy
description: A method to prevent the over-saturation of Low Earth Orbit, averting global infrastructure failure and ensuring humanity retains access to space.

title: How should limited school mental-health support be allocated to minimise student harm?
description: My project tackles how limited mental-health support can be allocated fairly to students most at risk of deterioration. This matters because delays can worsen wellbeing and deepen inequality.

title: Mitigation of Paddy Rice Production
description: My project tackles the problem of greenhouse gases being emitted from rice farming, and looks at optimising alternative ways.

title: Antivenomics — A Budget-Optimal Allocation Model For India's 58,000 Annual Snakebite Deaths
description: Within global health, 58K Indians die from snakebite every year, yet most cases are preventable with $7 of antivenom. It's one of the world's biggest killers yet it receives little funding.

title: Sahel Health Access Optimizer
description: Millions in the Sahel lack timely access to healthcare. I optimize where new clinics should be built to maximize population coverage with limited resources.

title: Deciphering ciphers: mitigating RSA vulnerabilities
description: RSA remains critical in billions of systems, so preventing weak key generation is essential. Vulnerabilities like ROCA show the need for stronger protection during the transition to PQC.

title: Cost-Effectiveness of Emergency Digital Infrastructure in Conflict Zones
description: Educational disruption in conflict zones loses millions of schooling hours. We model low-cost digital infrastructure ($95/student) to recover 75% of learning and protect human capital (9-12x ROI).

title: Arithmophobia in Egyptian Classrooms: Causes and Solutions of Math Anxiety in Elementary Students
description: Mathematics anxiety is a specific form of anxiety that impairs students' performance, well-being, and long-term educational outcomes, particularly when it begins in early schooling.

title: Game-Theoretic Analysis of US-EU trade war
description: My project aims to make clearer the motivations behind the trade conflicts between the United States and the European Union and propose a mechanism to reduce impact.

title: Predicting Coastal Microplastic Accumulation using Shallow Water Navier Stokes Equations
description: A lightweight, transparent model estimating wind effects on coastal microplastic accumulation. Offers free, scenario-based guidance for organisations lacking ocean forecasting tools.

title: Tackling hospital bed scarcity in the UK
description: Our project tackles the issue of there not being enough hospital beds within hospitals in the UK whilst patient demands increase, taking a statistical angle to minimise the issue.

title: EduConnect
description: Education is free, but not all education is equal. 53% of top-college students are from top 20% neighborhoods by income. 6% are from bottom 20%. Degrees double income, causing generational inequality.

title: Aqua-Guard
description: Many rural communities cannot easily check if their water is safe. Lab testing is slow and expensive, so people often drink contaminated water, causing preventable diseases and health risks.

title: Quantifying Urban Heat Risk: A Composite Index Combining Thermal Hazards and Population Vulnerability
description: Urban areas face amplified heat risk from the urban heat island effect. Identifying where residents are most endangered supports targeted long-term cooling measures and public-health protection.

title: Transit, Access & Equity: Hospital Accessibility Across Chicago
description: How transport accessibility affects access to healthcare in low-income areas. We are keeping in mind the broader goal of reducing economic inequality by first improving transportation networks.

title: Mathematical Optimization & Statistical Impact in Global Health Allocation
description: Optimizing neglected tropical disease interventions via ILP to maximize life-years saved. It bridges the gap between scarce public health resources and maximum human impact.

title: PrivacyBitCounter
description: UK social posts reveal clues like age, sex and location. Our checklist estimates how these details combine to identify someone, helping users assess their privacy risk before they share more wisely.

title: How should a limited number of internet towers be placed to maximise population coverage?
description: The project tackles the digital divide across countries which contributes to lower development countries getting less opportunities in education and resources.

title: Dialing in the machine: Cost-effective AI chest-X-ray screening for tuberculosis in prisons
description: I had TB for 3 years as a student. My project uses a maths model to find the best AI X-ray screening schedule for prisons, catching hidden TB early and saving lives at $93 per healthy life-year.

title: Estimating the Cost-Effectiveness of Pandemic Surveillance Systems
description: Pandemics are simultaneously catastrophic, recurrent, and systematically underinvested against. COVID-19 caused an estimated 14.9 million excess deaths in 2020–2021 alone.

title: QuakeNet
description: QuakeNet models Indonesia's risk chain and cascading hazards affecting local communities, revealing dangers standard single-event models miss.

title: Does the ice actually kill?
description: Farmed shrimp welfare. 440bn are killed each year. Whether ice-slurry slaughter actually kills them changes cost-effectiveness 21x — and no one has measured it. It's a stopwatch.

title: Equity-Aware Load-Shedding Optimisation
description: Traditional power load shedding maximizes raw utility while ignoring vulnerable zones, causing severe societal harm. Our equity-aware tool balances power fairly.

title: MaxiMedRelief
description: In a crisis, health systems are stuck with rising medical demands and limited resources. MERCY optimizes medical capability, allocating resources where staff, equipment and access join to deliver impact.

title: Where Mathematics Meets Medicine: Spectral Graph Theory and Dose-Response Modelling to Tackle AMR in Hospitals
description: AMR kills millions and threatens modern medicine. Hospitals lack proactive ways to stop super-spreaders. We tackle this by using math to target isolation before outbreaks begin.

title: Surveillance Debt
description: Shared surveillance infrastructure is eroding: U.S. measles hit a 35-year high as MMR coverage falls, while efficient H5N1 testing still misses 2-9% of real cases. One root cause, two live crises.

title: Scoring LLMs for Policy: A Mathematical Framework for Proactive Auditing of LLMs
description: Regulators have no way of checking an LLM's safety before mass use. This paper proposes a mathematical framework for analysing LLMs.

title: GridShield AI
description: GridShield AI uses mathematical optimization and AI to fairly distribute limited electricity, protecting hospitals and critical infrastructure while reducing blackouts during power shortages.

title: Chakra
description: Climate variability makes planting decisions increasingly uncertain for small farmers in Cusco, Peru, who lack accessible decision-support tools based on environmental data.

title: Evacuation Route for Earthquake
description: We built a system that uses graph theory to optimize emergency vehicle routes in Tokyo after earthquakes by dynamically recalculating the safest and fastest paths.

title: Proximity: A Tumor Microenvironment Spatial Architecture Analysis Tool
description: Melanoma pathology counts T-cells but neglects their distance from tumor cells, but spatial exclusion by stromal barriers predicts immune evasion better than cell count alone.

title: Antivenom Reserve: A screening rule for splitting scarce medical stock between regions
description: Antivenom shortages leave Kenyan patients without timely treatment. This project tests how to place the same fixed stock more fairly and efficiently across regions.

title: Road Risk
description: Interactive road-risk map for loading OpenStreetMap roads, sampling TomTom traffic, spotting congestion, and comparing route exposure.

title: MeshTriage
description: Natural disasters cripple communication, leaving victims unable to call for help and responders without real-time information, delaying rescue and increasing preventable deaths.

title: Calibrating Cardiac Risk Using a Medicine Allocation Model for Sri Lankans
description: Cardiovascular disease models currently use Western data which is not relevant for South Asian populations due to genetic and environmental factors which means that they are more susceptible to CVDs.

title: A Prototype Optimization Model for Neonatal Healthcare Facility Placement
description: An optimization model for siting neonatal healthcare facilities. (Submitted without a written summary — description pending from the team.)

title: The Interpretability Residual: measuring what AI audits miss
description: AI safety relies on interpretability, yet current metrics don't quantify unexplained model behaviour. This project proposes a decision framework for measuring that uncertainty.

title: Data Center Environmental Impact Prediction
description: The project measures the impact varied types of data centers would have in high resource-stressed regions.

title: Mapping Inclusion
description: 28% of UK mosques lack women's spaces. Current decisions for where new mosques are built are made without considering locations where they could most benefit the female Muslim community.

title: Neural Network To Predict Wildfire Risk
description: With risks of wildfires increasing due to climate change and extreme weather I aimed in this project to find a way to predict high risk periods of time using NASA data to help prepare.

title: AI Safety Funding Is Misaligned with Catastrophic Risk
description: Improving how AI safety funding is prioritized by comparing current investments with expert assessments of catastrophic AI risk.
